content: <p><strong>Location:</strong> Vienna (Hybrid) &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Reports to:</strong> Head of People Operations &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Scope:</strong> Austria &amp; Germany, multiple legal entities</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>The role in a snapshot</strong></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Love making things work better - and making work better for people? Then let’s talk.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are a tech-first scale-up, and our People Operations team runs like one. As People Operations Manager DACH, you will own HR operations for Austria and Germany across multiple legal entities. You are the go-to person for employees and managers and the one who keeps contracts, payroll inputs and policies spot-on. Beyond the day-to-day, we are excited to see you implement your own ideas for automation and improvements, or join existing initiatives we run to streamline our day-to-day and drive operational excellence. You will team up with our Head of People Operations, our People Systems &amp; Payroll Specialist and P&amp;O colleagues across all our markets.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Employee relations &amp; compliance</strong></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Be the trusted voice on employee relations and labour-law compliance in Austria and Germany across multiple legal entities, pulling in internal and external legal counsel when it counts.</li> <li>Be the first stop for P&amp;O questions from employees and managers across our Austrian and German entities - with answers people actually understand.</li> <li>Coach managers on P&amp;O policies and procedures, so doing the right thing becomes the easy thing.</li> <li>Bring group P&amp;O policies to life locally, create DACH-specific ones where needed, and be our partner to the Works Council.</li> <li>Be the DACH point of contact for internal and external audit</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;&
